context: Transcript-derived first-pass implementation scenario from Symphony for Trello: the agent introduced isPresent()/get() while writing retry backoff code with an optional Retry-After header.

checklist.name: Creates requested class
checklist.description: Creates RetryBackoff.java with RetryBackoff, backoff(Config, int, HttpResponse<?>), parseRetryAfter(String), and the nested Config record.

checklist.name: Uses Optional boundary for Retry-After
checklist.description: Uses Optional.ofNullable(response).flatMap(...).orElseGet(...) or an equivalent direct Optional boundary for the header result.

checklist.name: No presence-check value read
checklist.description: Does not use isPresent()/isEmpty() followed by get() or orElseThrow() for the Retry-After header Optional or parsed duration Optional.

checklist.name: No null or fake collection workaround
checklist.description: Does not use orElse(null), local null branching for the parsed duration, Optional.stream().toList(), lists, or loops to unwrap one Optional.

checklist.name: Preserves fallback behavior
checklist.description: Returns the exponential backoff only when response is null or the header is absent or invalid, and uses Math.min(attempt - 1, 8) for the shift cap.

checklist.name: Parses only positive whole seconds
checklist.description: parseRetryAfter returns Optional.of(Duration.ofSeconds(seconds)) only for positive whole-number seconds and Optional.empty() for blank, zero, negative, malformed, or null values.
